title: Medium-sized · adj.
subtitle: 「中等大小／不大不小／中型」，究竟是哪一種 medium-sized？
description: 「中等大小／不大不小／中型」，究竟是哪一種 medium-sized？

words.meaning: 大小適中的；中等大小的
words.note: 使用者提供。這是 medium-sized 最直接、最透明的解釋性改寫之一，表示尺寸不大也不小，處於中間範圍。它適合一般物件、房間、建築、企業等。
words.example: They moved into a house that is moderate in size but well designed.

exercises.original: They chose a medium-sized meeting room for the twelve-person workshop.
exercises.zh: 他們為十二人的工作坊選了一個大小適中的會議室。
exercises.upgrade: moderate in size · 大小適中的；中等大小的

options.explanation: twelve people require neither a tiny room nor a large hall; the clue is simply balanced size.
最透明的 plain-English 定義，明確排除 large 和 small 兩端。 本題的決定性線索是 general middle-range room size；這裡需要的是「一般性的大小適中」。因此 neither large nor small 雖與 medium-sized 有重疊，但是否要求分類標籤、平均基準、兩端比較或營運規模並不最吻合。

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者非常接近；midsize 更常作固定分類標籤，尤其是車輛、企業與城市。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It is a midsize SUV. It is a medium-sized suitcase.

falseSynonyms.zh: average-sized 需要相對某一同類群體的平均或典型尺寸；medium-sized 不一定有統計比較基準。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The dog is average-sized for its breed. They bought a medium-sized table.

falseSynonyms.zh: moderate 本身可表示程度、價格、速度等『適中』，不一定是尺寸；要表大小通常說 moderate in size。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The risk is moderate. The room is moderate in size.

falseSynonyms.zh: intermediate 表示位於兩個級別／階段中間，未必是物理尺寸；要說尺寸通常用 intermediate in size。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON This is an intermediate course. The specimen is intermediate in size.

falseSynonyms.zh: medium-scale 主要說 project/operation/business 的規模；普通箱子、狗、房間不能自然叫 medium-scale。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It is a medium-scale project. It is a medium-sized box.

falseSynonyms.zh: mid-range 常表示價格、性能或市場定位在中間，而不一定是物理尺寸。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON This is a mid-range phone. This is a medium-sized phone.

falseSynonyms.zh: average 可表示一般、普通或數學平均，不能直接等於『中等大小』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The average score was 72. The box is medium-sized.

falseSynonyms.zh: medium 可作尺寸標籤，但也有媒介、程度、烹調熟度等多義；medium-sized 更明確說物理大小／規模。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I'll take a medium coffee. They run a medium-sized company.
